name: Leil Como 4-180 4-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Leil Como 4-180 4-Person Indoor Sauna Features Premium 40mm ThermoWood® Construction : Thermally modified Scandinavian pine walls deliver exceptional insulation, moisture resistance, and dimensional stability, ensuring decades of reliable use without warping, rotting, or resin leakage even with frequent group sauna sessions. Generously Sized 4-Person Design : Spacious 1.81-meter width and 1.60-meter depth with 5.0+ cubic meter interior volume provides ample room for four adults to sit comfortably or partially recline, making it ideal for family wellness and small group gatherings. Three-Level Bench System : Innovative multi-level seating configuration with two top benches (500mm x 1332mm each), large single bottom bench (400mm x 1684mm), and integrated step bench (400mm x 800mm) with coordinating backrests for flexible, ergonomic positioning. Tempered Glass Front Door : Premium 8mm clear tempered glass door with black hardware and premium handle creates an open, contemporary aesthetic while maintaining excellent heat retention and durability for long-term daily use by groups. Two-Piece Insulated Ceiling : 15mm thermally modified ThermoWood® ceiling panels (969mm and 719mm sections) enhance heat retention, improve heat distribution, and simplify installation while maintaining structural integrity across the larger interior space. Vertical Bar Front Wall Design : Clean minimalist architecture with vertical bar facade creates sophisticated Scandinavian aesthetic while providing structural support and allowing unobstructed views into your wellness space for social sauna experiences. Engineered Soft Heat Airflow System : Adjustable ceiling vent and elevated base airflow design with expanded ventilation clearance (600mm x 720mm) create balanced humidity-to-temperature ratio, preventing dry heat sensation and enabling longer, deeper therapeutic sessions. Adjustable Feet & Leveling System : 14 M8x40 adjustable legs with rubber pads (versus 13 on smaller models) provide enhanced stability and allow precise leveling on any indoor surface type, ensuring proper structural alignment for the larger sauna. Optional LED Lighting & Hexagon DECO Panels : Customizable ambient lighting system and large decorative hexagon mosaic back wall panel (1684mm x 1593mm) transform your sauna into an elegant wellness sanctuary with spa-quality ambiance for group gatherings. Modular Pre-Fabricated Assembly Kit : Pre-fabricated wall logs and ceiling elements with modular design allow four-five people to complete assembly in 7-10 hours using basic tools, with detailed instructions and all fasteners included in the comprehensive kit. Nordic Heritage Engineering : Handcrafted in Estonia with 16+ years of sauna expertise, combining contemporary Nordic design with traditional sauna culture and rigorous testing for authentic, reliable performance in larger group settings. Professional-Grade Construction for Hospitality Use : Engineered for both residential and commercial applications, the Como 4-180 delivers the durability and design quality required for boutique spas, wellness centers, and properties seeking premium sauna experiences. Leil Como 4-180 Specifications Product Name Leil Como 4-180 4-Person Indoor Sauna Kit Model Number Como 4-180 Capacity 4 persons maximum Exterior Width 1,810mm (71.3 inches / 5.9 feet) Exterior Depth 1,600mm (63.0 inches / 5.2 feet) Exterior Height 2,200mm (86.6 inches / 7.2 feet) Interior Width 1,692mm (66.7 inches) Interior Depth 1,353mm (53.3 inches) Interior Height 2,085mm (82.1 inches) Interior Volume Approximately 5.0+ cubic meters (176+ cubic feet) Floor Area Footprint 2.9 square meters (31.2 square feet) Wall Thickness 40mm (1.57 inches) ThermoWood® Ceiling Thickness 15mm STS ThermoWood® with two-piece insulated panels (969mm and 719mm) Door Type Clear tempered 8mm glass with black hardware and premium handle Bench Configuration Three-level system: Two top benches (500mm x 1332mm each), single bottom bench (400mm x 1684mm), step bench (400mm x 800mm), integrated backrests on multiple levels Estimated Assembly Weight 850-950 kg (1,870-2,090 lbs) assembled Shipping/Crate Weight Varies with packaging, shipped LTL freight Assembly Time 7-10 hours with 4-5 people (4-5 persons recommended for optimal efficiency) Warranty 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering materials, manufacturing defects, and pre-transport damage Material Standards Nordic Lunawood ThermoWood® (thermally modified pine), tempered glass, stainless steel hardware, Aspen benches Ventilation System Adjustable ceiling vent (100mm), elevated base airflow with expanded dual-opening design (600mm x 720mm clearance) Heater Compatibility Optional electric heaters 8-11kW recommended (HUUM Drop 9, Saunum, Harvia KIP 8 models; sold separately) Electrical Requirements 220-240V hardwired connection with dedicated breaker (heater-dependent amperage, typically 40-60 amps for 8-11kW heaters; 120V recommended for LED lighting) Floor Installation Requirements Stable, level surface with concrete foundation or driven piles; 600mm x 720mm minimum clearance around sauna required Adjustable Legs 14 M8x40 adjustable legs with rubber pads (additional supports for larger interior volume) Design Awards Red Dot: Best of the Best 2024 international design recognition Customization Options Standard or Hexagon DECO decorative back wall panel (1684mm x 1593mm), LED lighting packages (top benches and backrest options), various heater packages for commercial/residential use Assembly Kit Includes Pre-fabricated wall logs, two ceiling elements, tempered glass door, three-level bench system with multiple backrests, ventilation valve, 14 adjustable legs with rubber pads, all fasteners and hardware, electrical cable conduit, comprehensive installation manual Leil Como 4-180 Frequently Asked Questions Can four adults fit comfortably in the Como 4-180, and what is the seating arrangement? Yes, the Como 4-180 is engineered for comfortable 4-person use with its spacious 1.69-meter interior width and innovative three-level bench system. The configuration includes two top benches, one extended bottom bench, and a step bench, all with integrated backrests. This allows four adults to sit at different heights with ample room and support, or allows flexible positioning such as two people reclining on top benches while two sit upright on lower levels. The 2,085mm interior height accommodates seated and reclined positions for extended group wellness sessions. What size room or space is required for the Como 4-180? The Como 4-180 exterior dimensions are 1,810mm wide x 1,600mm deep x 2,200mm tall. For proper installation and access, plan for a room at least 2,400mm x 2,200mm (7'10" x 7'2") minimum, with 600mm x 720mm clearance space on all sides recommended for ventilation, airflow, and maintenance access. The sauna can be positioned in a corner by assembling wall logs first, then pushing against walls, but ensure adequate ventilation around the roof area. A ceiling height of at least 2,400mm is recommended to accommodate the 2,200mm sauna plus airflow above. What heater capacity should I choose for the Como 4-180, and are heaters included? Heaters are sold separately and not included with the sauna kit. For the Como 4-180's 5.0+ cubic meter interior volume, we recommend electric heaters in the 8-11kW capacity range. Leil particularly recommends HUUM Drop 9 (9kW) which features patented air-blending technology that mixes hot ceiling air with cooler floor air, creating balanced warmth and eliminating "cold feet" for four people. Alternative options include higher-capacity Saunum or Harvia KIP 8 models. Consult manufacturer heater sizing recommendations or contact sales to match your specific heat output needs for larger group sessions. How difficult is assembly, and do I need professional installation? The Como 4-180 uses pre-fabricated modular wall logs that are easier to assemble than traditional barrel staves. Four to five capable people can complete assembly in 7-10 hours following the detailed installation manual included with your kit. Four to five people are recommended for handling the larger wall panels and installing the heavy tempered glass door safely. No professional installation is required if you have basic tools (hammer, screwdriver, drill) and follow instructions carefully. However, electrical wiring must be completed by a certified electrician to ensure safety and compliance with local electrical codes. What is ThermoWood® and why is it better than regular cedar for saunas? ThermoWood® is Scandinavian pine that is heat-treated using only heat and steam (no chemicals) to remove internal moisture and resins. This thermal modification creates wood that is naturally resistant to warping, shrinking, rotting, and insect damage—far superior to untreated cedar, hemlock, or softwoods. ThermoWood® won't leak sticky resin even in extreme heat, maintains dimensional stability for decades without twisting, and develops a beautiful natural patina over time. The Como 4-180's 40mm thick ThermoWood® walls provide exceptional insulation, heat retention, and durability compared to standard sauna materials, supporting frequent group use. Can I customize the Como 4-180 with lighting or decorative back wall panels? Yes, the Como 4-180 offers excellent customization options. You can add optional LED lighting systems in multiple configurations that provide warm ambient illumination across the larger interior space. The standard back wall can be upgraded to a large Hexagon DECO decorative panel (1684mm x 1593mm) that adds visual elegance and spa-quality aesthetics to complement your interior design. These options can be selected during purchase or added as upgrades, allowing you to personalize your group wellness space and create the perfect atmosphere for family gatherings and entertaining. Does the Como 4-180 include a warranty, and what does it cover? The Como 4-180 includes a comprehensive 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering defects in materials, manufacturing quality, and any damage occurring before transportation delivery. The warranty does not cover natural wood variations (such as color changes, knots, or small cracks), normal wear and tear from regular use, incorrect assembly or installation, force majeure events (natural disasters, wars), or unauthorized modifications. Claims must be filed within the warranty period by contacting the manufacturer with photographic documentation of the defect. Warranty coverage differs for commercial use models. Is the Como 4-180 suitable for commercial or spa use? Yes, the Como 4-180 is engineered for both residential and commercial applications. Its premium construction, durable ThermoWood® materials, three-level bench system, and generous capacity make it ideal for boutique spas, wellness centers, hospitality properties, vacation rentals, and commercial establishments seeking to offer premium sauna experiences. The design quality and professional-grade components ensure it can withstand frequent group use while maintaining aesthetic appeal and functionality. Contact sales regarding commercial-specific features, warranty terms, and heater packages optimized for business environments. What are the electrical and site preparation requirements for the Como 4-180? The Como 4-180 requires a stable, level floor prepared with a concrete foundation or driven piles to ensure structural integrity and prevent settling over time. The sauna requires a 220-240V hardwired connection with a dedicated breaker for the electric heater (specific amperage depends on your chosen heater model, typically 40-60 amps for 8-11kW heaters). A dedicated 120V connection is also recommended for LED lighting and control systems if you order those options. We strongly recommend confirming exact electrical specifications with a qualified electrician based on your heater selection before installation to ensure full compliance with local electrical codes and safety standards. How long will the Como 4-180 last, and what maintenance does it require? With proper care, the Como 4-180 can provide 20+ years of reliable performance thanks to its ThermoWood® construction and premium materials. Annual maintenance is recommended: apply UV-protective exterior varnish to maintain color and protect against moisture/weathering, and treat wooden benches with specialized sauna bench oils for smooth, long-lasting comfort across the multi-level seating. The tempered glass door and stainless hardware require only routine cleaning with mild soap and water. Ensure proper ventilation during and after use to manage humidity. Regular maintenance preserves the sauna's structural integrity, appearance, and function throughout its lifetime of group use.
